LIST.TITLE: WhatsApp Templates
LIST.SUBTITLE: Manage your Twilio Content templates for WhatsApp messaging
LIST.SYNC_ERROR: Failed to sync templates. Please try again.
LIST.LOAD_ERROR: Failed to load templates. Please try again.
LIST.CREATE_SUCCESS: Template created successfully. It will appear once synced.
LIST.SAVE_ERROR: Failed to save template. Please try again.
LIST.DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
LIST.DELETE_ERROR: Failed to delete template. Please try again.

FORM.NAME: Template Name
FORM.NAME_HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only. Max 450 characters.
FORM.NAME_INVALID: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are allowed.
FORM.BODY_HINT: Use {'{{'}1{'}}'}, {'{{'}2{'}}'}, etc. as placeholders for dynamic variables.
FORM.MEDIA_URL_HINT: Direct link to an image, video, or document file.
FORM.BUTTON_ID_HINT: Unique identifier. Not visible to the recipient.
FORM.SAMPLE_VALUES_DESC: Provide a sample value for each variable. WhatsApp requires these to review your template for approval.

APPROVAL.TITLE: Submit for WhatsApp review
APPROVAL.DESCRIPTION: This entire template will be submitted for WhatsApp approval. WhatsApp usually approves or rejects template submissions in 48 hours or less.
APPROVAL.WA_NAME_HINT: Must be lowercase with underscores. This is the name WhatsApp uses to identify the template.

CATEGORIES.UTILITY_DESC: Facilitate a specific, agreed-upon request or transaction or update to a customer about an ongoing transaction, including post-purchase notifications and recurring billing statements.
CATEGORIES.MARKETING_DESC: Include promotions or offers, informational updates, or invitations for customers to respond or take action. Any conversation that does not qualify as utility or authentication is a marketing conversation.

APPROVAL.VARIABLE_SAMPLES_DESC: Provide a sample value for each variable. WhatsApp requires this to review your template.
APPROVAL.SUCCESS: Template submitted for WhatsApp approval. Status will update after review.
APPROVAL.ERROR: Failed to submit for approval. Please try again.
